mostWorthwhile.text: Developing different island songs was most worthwhile: it distinguished inherited variation from learned traditions.

leastWorthwhile.text: The island-to-bird connection was sensible but predictable, especially as it was the only offered combination.

surprise.text: I was interested that song differences could reflect both learning and inherited variation, rather than genetics alone.

arbitrary.text: Connecting different songs directly to a food web felt somewhat abstract; the result described communities rather than showing a specific feeding relationship.

continue.text: I would probably continue for the educational explanations, though the mostly single-option sequence offered limited meaningful choice.
